text: On the day of the festival, the whole city came to watch. Pharaoh brought the best magicians in Egypt.
Musa said: you throw first. And they threw down their ropes and their staffs.
And by their magic, they seemed to be moving, like snakes. Even Musa felt a fear inside himself.
Allah said: "Fear not. Indeed, it is you who are superior. And throw what is in your right hand."
Musa threw his staff. And it swallowed up everything they had made.
The magicians knew magic better than anyone. And they knew: this was not magic.
They fell down in prostration, all of them, in front of Pharaoh, and said: "We have believed in the Lord of Harun and Musa."
Pharaoh was furious. He threatened to cut off their hands and feet, and crucify them on the trunks of palm trees.
They answered: "Never will we prefer you over the clear proofs that have come to us, and over the One who created us. So decree whatever you will. You can only decree for this worldly life."
They came that morning as magicians. They left as believers.
